approval.button.always: Fallback label of Hermes' own approval button (Desktop: 'Always allow'). At runtime Hermes' translation replaces it when it has one; use the Desktop's own wording for this language.
approval.button.reject: Fallback label of Hermes' own approval button (Desktop: 'Reject'). Hermes' translation replaces it when it has one.
approval.button.run: Fallback label of Hermes' own approval button (Desktop: 'Run'). Hermes' translation replaces it when it has one.
approval.button.session: Fallback label of Hermes' own approval button (Desktop: 'Allow this session'). Hermes' translation replaces it when it has one.
ask.prompt: Approval prompt shown above Hermes' buttons. {run} {reject} {session} {always} are the button labels: quote them as your language does for UI labels. {why} is one of the ask.why.* sentences.
ask.spot: Approval prompt of a random spot check. {run} {reject} {session} {always} are Hermes' button labels.
carry.kept: Appended after carry.new_agent, separated by a space.
cli.col.number: Column header of the undo id. Keep it very short (1-3 characters).
cli.count.agents: Count phrase inserted into other sentences (cli.revoke.done).
cli.count.checks: Count phrase used in the 'record' column: '{faults} / {checks}'. English keeps the plural for 1 to stay byte-identical with v1.
cli.count.faults: Count phrase used in the 'record' column. English keeps the plural for 1 to stay byte-identical with v1.
cli.list.joiner: Separator between notes or preset levels on one line.
cli.list.separator: Separator between names in a list (agents, types).
cli.passport.summary: {types} and {events} are count phrases; {redaction} and {signature} are cli.passport.* words.
cli.presets.footer: {command} is the slash command to type, {setting} the config key, {example} a config value: never translate them.
cli.presets.line: {name} is a preset name the owner types (careful, balanced, fast): do not translate it. {levels} is the list of cli.presets.level items.
cli.presets.line_default: Same as cli.presets.line, for the default preset.
cli.status.notes: Table cell: the guarantee, then notes in brackets.
cli.usage: Usage block of /tenure. Keep every left-column command and option exactly as written and the alignment with spaces; translate only the right-column descriptions.
stakes.high: Stakes level as shown in sentences and tables ('high stakes'). The config value stays 'high'.
stakes.low: Stakes level as shown in sentences and tables. The config value stays 'low'.
stakes.medium: Stakes level as shown in sentences and tables. The config value stays 'medium'.
tier.short.alone: Tier name in tables and notices. Keep the 'T3' prefix.
tier.short.ask: Tier name in tables and notices. Keep the 'T1' prefix.
tier.short.notify: Tier name in tables and notices. Keep the 'T2' prefix.
undo.refused: {reason} is one of the undo.refused.* phrases (lower case, no final period).
